page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head "CA." at top centre; page number "101" at top right; catchword "Casibus" at bottom right; signature "G 3" at bottom centre. Faint show-through from the reverse page is not transcribed. No margin notes.

main_text.p: pressum, Virg. Lac passum. Lactis coacti massa, Ovid. Caseus manu pressus, Suet.
Cassis] Rete, Virg. Plagae, Ovid. Panthera, omnis generis feras capiens, Cerda. Tendicula, Sipont. Viscum, Id.

Castigare] Arguere aliquem avaritiae. Coercere, Cic. Incessere monitis amaris, Sil. Concastigare, Plaut. Admonere monimentis bubulis, Id. Corripere peccatum, Ovid. Objurgare flagris, ferulis, Suet. Corrigere natum, Ter.
Castigaberis] Non hoc sic abibit, Ter. Non inultum aufferes, Id.
Castitas] Castimonia, Cic. Castusanimus, Id. Castitudo, Non. Castus, ûs, Var. Soror sobrietatis.
Castitas suspecta] Foris Helena, Intus Hecuba.
Castra] Stativa, Liv. Sepimentum militare, Varr. Munitio. Operibus munitionibusque cingere urbem, Cic. Castra stativa, Id.
Castra metari] Castra alicubi locare, ponere, habere, collocare castra, tabernaculum, Cic. Castra facere, Caes. Carraginem facere, Treb.
Castrare] Virilitatem amputare, Plin. Privare parte virilitatis, Fest. Genitalia incidere, Id. Privare sexu, Arnob. vid. Evirare.
Castratio] Eviratio, Sen. Detestatio, Apul. Castratura, Plin.
Castratus] Exsectus, Cic. Excastratus caper, Gell. Eviratus, Plaut. Praecisus, Lampr.
Castrum] Castrum natura munitum, Cic. Burgus, Veget.
Castus] Purus. Integer, Cic. Abstinentissimus Veneris. Abstinentissimus rebus Venereis, Col. Perintegrae castitatis, Gell. Lucretiâ, Penelope castior. Vestarum toro purior.
Casus](1) Prolapsio, Lapsio: Proclivitas ad lapsionem, Cic. Lapsus, Sil. Procidentia, Plin. Petitus terra, Lucr.

Casus] (2) Pro fortuna accidentibus frangi. Casus repentinus, Cic. Eventus, Id. Doleo vicem tuam, Id. Communem belli Martem, casumque. Alea, Id. Humanam sortem, Ovid. Fortunâ. Forte cecidit, Ter. Accidentiam naturae morari, Plin. Fortuitus eventus, Id.

page.notes: Faint show-through from the facing page is visible in the middle of the text area and is omitted. Some letters are blurred, notably "Caesar"/"Caf." and "Carraginem" (likely "Caraginem"); transcribed as printed.
